reuse.why: Puts the check in the existing single linkBankSyncAccount function that every provider's link path already goes through.

duplication.why: One query and one throw, added once; nothing is repeated per provider.

placement.why: Right layer (the shared link flow, before any write), though the inline SQL could sit as a named helper in link.ts beside findOrCreateBank.

scope.why: A nine-line change confined to the link flow.

maintainability.why: Small, readable guard at the top of the one link definition; easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link functions call linkBankSyncAccount, which now holds the guard.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, the single link definition used by every provider.
